title: Garlic Butter Crusty Bread
description: Soft, golden bread with a crispy crust and a rich garlic butter topping — perfect for any meal.

method.instruction: In a large bowl, combine lukewarm milk, sugar, and yeast. Let sit for 5 minutes until slightly foamy.
Add the egg, 300 g bread flour, and 4.5 g of the salt. Mix until a rough dough forms.
Add 15 g of the unsalted butter and knead for 8–10 minutes until the dough is smooth, elastic, and no longer sticky.
Place dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover with a damp tea towel, and let rise in a warm place for 1–1½ hours or until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and shape into a tight oval or log. Place in a greased loaf tin or on a lined baking tray.
Cover and let rise for another 45–60 minutes until puffy.
Meanwhile, make the garlic butter: mix the remaining 20 g of softened unsalted butter, minced garlic, honey, the remaining 2 g of salt, and chopped parsley until well combined.
Bake for 18–22 minutes until golden brown and the loaf sounds hollow when tapped on the bottom.
Remove from oven and immediately brush the hot loaf generously with the garlic butter mixture.
Let cool for 10 minutes before slicing. Serve warm.

notes.title: Garlic Butter Timing
notes.content: Brush the garlic butter on while the loaf is hot from the oven — it melts into the crust and soaks into the bread. Doing it cold will leave butter sitting on top.

notes.title: Serving Tip
notes.content: Serve warm with extra garlic butter on the side for dipping, or alongside pasta, soups, or salads.
